item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day is full of reminders about mindset and routine, so build food into that same structure. Eating on autopilot or skipping meals usually shows up as lower patience and fuzzy thinking later. Plan your next meal now, around protein and something green, and eat it sitting down without screens. Notice when you're actually hungry versus just stressed. Your action: decide what you're eating for your next meal, right now.
